method: Read-only static review of frozen source; no compilation, benchmark, or test execution by this reviewer.

valid_wire_static_conclusion.status: No hard-constraint mismatch found for validated Zstandard mapped tables.
valid_wire_static_conclusion.domain: Resolved LL/OF/ML compressed modes; extras bounded by LL16/OF31/ML16 and transitions by LL9/OF8/ML9; valid bounded reader.
preserved: remaining_bits commits at each individual field boundary
match/literal checked addition before subsequent field reads or offset resolution
repeat offset resolution before remaining decrement
LL/ML/OF transition order and per-field state commits
last-sequence transition omission and final expectEnd order
unchanged private literal staging, copying, continuation commit and output guards
valid_wire_static_conclusion.fast_group_initializer: Group.initProven loads a suffix without consuming reader progress; manual decrements follow successful field extraction.

test_coverage.group_fast_exercised_by: Current normalized multi-sequence chains and real long fixtures contain fast-path inputs; reviewed statically, no new branch-hit counts captured.
test_coverage.fallback_exercised_by: Short logical bitstreams, total groups above 56, and stratified truncated chains/fixtures.
test_coverage.extra_transactions: remaining=1 with exactly extra payload, so fast condition cannot hold: payload>=64 implies total_bits>56. These transactions only exercise fallback.
test_coverage.repcode_error_transactions: Explicit repcode failure and missing-ML fixture use at most 47 logical bits and do not specifically exercise group-fast errors.
test_coverage.physical_padding: Appending bytes while leaving remaining_bits unchanged does not force fast-path admission.
missing_dedicated_fast_errors: repeat-offset InvalidMatch with a long suffix
32-bit checked arithmetic failure after OF/ML or OF/ML/LL field commits
last-sequence expectEnd failure with a long suffix
test_coverage.reported_13_of_13_limit: Reported prior 13/13 pass is not proof of every group-fast error ordering or transaction. This reviewer did not rerun that suite.

strict_private_domain_caveat.issue: u8 width sums can overflow on invalid private metadata; total_bits<=56 does not prove each Group.read width<=32.
strict_private_domain_caveat.example: LL(base=1,extra=0), OF(base=1,extra=33), ML(base=3,extra=0), zero state widths, remaining=2, nine zero bytes ending in 01 => remaining_bits=64.
strict_private_domain_caveat.generic_behavior: 64-bit generic reader accepts the 33-bit field; 32-bit generic reader returns CorruptFrame without consuming it.
strict_private_domain_caveat.specialized_behavior: ReleaseSafe Group.read(33) violates its width assertion; a zero-valued 33-bit field can pass in 32-bit ReleaseFast instead of the generic error.
strict_private_domain_caveat.followup: Encode the validated-mapping capability or safely widen/check sums and individual field widths before claiming strict equality on arbitrary private mapped entries.

performance_decision.basis: Main screened candidate did not meet the 20-percent target-row improvement. No new measurement by this reviewer.

further_optimization_prerequisite: Add dedicated group-fast failure transactions and explicit coverage before treating a future faster reader as fully proven.
